title: DialogGuard: Multi-Agent Psychosocial Safety Evaluation of Sensitive LLM Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses for biased language, stereotypes, or unfair assumptions towards protected groups (including race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and nationality) using multiple LLM-as-a-judge architectures (single-agent scoring, dual-agent correction, multi-agent debate, and majority voting) and validating the predictions against human-annotated ground-truth labels from the PKU-SafeRLHF dataset.
